name: board_snapshot
protocol_phrase: The user prompt already includes a board_snapshot-style state summary; call `board_snapshot()` only if you need to reread or refresh the state.

name: legal_plays
protocol_phrase: Call `legal_plays()` before evaluating so you know the exact legal candidate domino_ids.

name: calculate_expected_utility
protocol_phrase: Call `calculate_expected_utility()` after `legal_plays()` to rank the current legal plays by integrated expected utility; use it as the main synthesis tool.

name: play_brief
protocol_phrase: Call `play_brief(play=X)` when you need to inspect the modes/catalysts behind the expected-utility ranking.

name: simulate_hand_impact
protocol_phrase: Call `simulate_hand_impact(play_id=X, seat='left_opp|partner|right_opp', holds=Y)` when a dominant information source or play brief catalyst needs targeted testing.

name: belief_trajectory
protocol_phrase: Call `belief_trajectory()` when you need the broader posterior over unseen dominoes, not just one ranking or hypothesis.
